run: Dashboard-hosted, signed in: load the W0 fixture with load-inspector-v4-site.mjs, then `node scripts/conformance/measure.mjs inspector-v4-02 --url <dashboard>/edit/<site> --storage-state <login state> --eval "$(node scripts/conformance/inspector-v4-state.mjs 2)"` and `diff.mjs inspector-v4-02`. W4 (2026-10-02) joined the targets below to specs/inspector-v4-02.json; the board-vs-live screenshot walk is the acceptance (build plan §4.3), this recipe is the regression net.

skipProps.height: Board column is 812 tall because the board draws a 32px status footer under the editor body; the shipped shell has no footer, so the column runs to the viewport bottom (844). Shell layout, not the Inspector.

skipProps.width: The column is 300 wide including its 1px left rule; content frames inside it measure 299. The board's 300-wide inner frames draw no rule.

skipProps.gap: Fixed-height chip (24px) centring a one-line label: the board's 2px vertical padding and 4px icon gap are drawn by the box height and the single text run (✦ AI), not by padding. Height, width and colours are compared.
